We publish a variety of newsletters featuring breaking news, deal analyses, people moves and the stories behind the headlines.

New private equity firm Equacy Capital Partners has bolstered its team with a spate of hires amid efforts to raise a debut fund.

Equacy, which comprises the former UK and Benelux teams of Equistone Partners Europe, spun out as an independent private equity firm last year.

It has now hired Lydia Blundell from Mayfair Equity Partners as head...

신생 사모펀드 운용사 Equacy Capital Partners가 첫 펀드 조성에 나선 가운데 잇단 영입으로 팀을 강화했다.
Equistone Partners Europe의 기존 영국·베네룩스 팀으로 구성된 Equacy는 지난해 독립 사모펀드 운용사로 분사했다.
Equacy는 이번에 Mayfair Equity Partners 출신 Lydia Blundell을 책임자로 영입했다...
